🔄 Content Update (Posted: October 26, 2026 / Previously listed: July 21, 2026)
Main changes: Date moved from September 24 to December 9; course extended from about 10 km to about 11 km; registration deadline moved from September 20 to December 5.

Event Details

Date: December 9 (Wednesday)

Assembly time: 10:00 a.m.

Assembly location: West parking lot of Hanno City Hall

Course: Hanno City Hall → Hanno River (Hanno-gawara) → Asahi-yama Overlook Park → Yuuhi-yama Park → Kanji-ji Temple → Saikoji Temple → Beside the purification center → Yagawa Bridge → Kawaji → Hanno City Hall

Distance: Approximately 11 kilometers

Estimated duration: About 3 hours 30 minutes

Fee: 200 yen (insurance and other costs; collected on the day)

What to bring: Packed lunch, drinks, rain gear, Sugo-Ashi handbook (if you have one)

Registration: Register with ASA Hanno by December 5 (Saturday)
Phone: 042-972-4701
Fax: 042-974-2190

Cancel check: For cancellations due to weather or other reasons, contact ASA Hanno after 9:00 a.m. on the day of the event.

Inquiries: Onda, 090-2205-8073

Hosted by: Hanno Walking Club

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/7601.html
summary: ℹ️ Sugo-Ashi Walking Event – Dec 9, 2026 (Wednesday) – Walk through Misugi-dai and Ochiai Nature
